notes.title: Update is here!
notes.content:
Hi fellows,

Meet new update!
Now you can play this great game on your Mac also!
DEMO version also available for OS X now.
Support for the following languages added:
Italian, Spanish, Portuguese-Brazil, Polish, Japanese.

Please have fun playing it!
